B-EIR5-01.defect: whatThisArtifactAdds[3] said 'thirty executed test vectors ... plus 4 new ones'.
B-EIR5-01.measured: The five arrays under $.testVectors hold 7+6+6+7+6 = 32. The BND group (sharedPrimitives-textComponent) holds 6, ids BND-1..BND-6. Carried = 32-6 = 26, which the sentence already had right.
B-EIR5-01.whyItSurvived: The file's own staleness register carried 'four new BND vectors' guarded by 'retired: there are six BND vectors' -- retired, then re-carried in a spelling the gate could not match, inside an allowlisted section. The v5 diff manifest edited items 0 and 6 of this very list for the stated reason 'the adds-list must describe v5, not v4'. Item 3 was not.
B-EIR5-01.note: F-1's separate 8-vector block is not part of this count and is not affected.

B-EIR5-02.defect: DUD-5's caveat asserted scalar-value order and UTF-8-byte order 'differ above the BMP'.
B-EIR5-02.measured: Exhaustive over all 1112064 valid Unicode scalars: 0 inversions between UTF-8 byte order and scalar order; they are one total order. UTF-16 has exactly 1 adjacent inversion, at U+FFFF vs U+10000.
B-EIR5-02.severity: The defect is not a misnamed encoding. Because the two named policies are ONE policy, the caveat was VACUOUS -- it disclosed a limitation that cannot exist -- and it displaced the real undetermined pair, which is live as canonical-json-profile.v1 UR-1 and reaches applied delivery.v4, whose release-manifest canonicalisation is defined as sha256 over JCS. RFC 8785 JCS sorts by UTF-16 code units.
B-EIR5-02.lineage: v5 inherited this from evidence-identity-recipes.v1 and replicated it into a v5-AUTHORED block absent from v4. Nine occurrences across seven artifacts carry the sentence. v1-v4 and evidence-identity-recipes.v2.review-independent are reviewed bytes and keep it permanently (freeze §7.2, §7.6). uncomputable-identity-fields.sweep.v1 is repaired by its own successor, sweep.v2, because it is hard-pinned by digest in ten artifacts.
